title: Jason Josephiac - Portable Alpha and Risk Mitigating Strategies (S6E6)

reader_summary.overview: Due to industry regulations, he will not discuss any of newfound researches funds on this podcast. Clients of Newfound Research Consultant at Makita Investment Group. Jason has largely spent his career in the institutional allocation space. First, in managing research at United Technology's pension and now on the consulting side of the table.

key_points.evidence_quote: Given this background, I spend the first half of the conversation trying to peel back the layers of how Jason thinks allocators should attack the portfolio construction process.

key_points.text: This includes his views on the risks of LDI, portable alpha in theory versus practice.
key_points.evidence_quote: This includes his views on the risks of LDI, portable alpha in theory versus practice, and why he prefers to view the world in a quote, absolute risk, absolute return framework.

key_points.text: In the back half of the conversation, we discussed Makita's Risk Managed Strategies Framework, with its three buckets of first responders, second responders.
key_points.evidence_quote: In the back half of the conversation, we discussed Makita's Risk Managed Strategies Framework, with its three buckets of first responders, second responders, and diversifiers.

key_points.text: We cover topics such as long volatility, managed futures, and what actually constitutes a diversifier.
